payload.title: Read the vault in the basicly ledger checks after the freeze

payload.acceptance_criteria:
When a person runs the four commands (install, init, link URL, migrate) in a git repository without the basicly harness, then the tracker is set up, the issues are imported, and claims, commits and pushes work with no runbook
When init has run and no link exists, then the local-only vault is a complete mode for one machine: every session there shares it, reads and writes stay local, and no remote is needed
When link URL runs on a local-only vault, then it adds sharing and backup without changing any other behaviour
When migrate imports an issues.jsonl (beads and other formats), then it removes personal data by default, writes the ignore lines, and verifies counts and digests itself
When a CI job runs the four commands in a fresh container with a sample issues.jsonl, in local-only mode and in linked mode, then both pass within a time budget (under 5 minutes for a basicly-sized repository, assumed)
When a fresh agent gets only the README, then it finishes the setup and migration without help
payload.description:
## Context
When a person adopts the tracker in any git repository, I want setup and migration in four commands, so claims, commits and pushes work with no runbook. Owner requirement relayed by the Orchestrator 2026-11-19 20:08 UTC, with the local-only mode added the same evening. Children, one per gap found today: push after freeze, checks reading the vault, freeze ignore lines, removing name and email, holder per session, scratch on disk. Design by swarm before any build, after tonight's three vault moves. No build yet.
payload.title: Standalone tracker setup and migration in four commands
